name: garmin-coach
description: Pulls Garmin data and provides daily readiness, training load, fitness trend, and recent activity coaching

tools.name: calibrate
tools.description: Compute personal HRV and resting HR baselines from the last 30 days of Garmin data. Runs automatically on first use and silently every 7 days. Call manually after a significant fitness change.

tools.name: get_morning_metrics
tools.description: Fetch overnight Garmin metrics (HRV, resting HR, sleep, body battery, stress) and return a daily readiness decision: GREEN / AMBER / RED

tools.name: get_training_load
tools.description: Fetch training status and compute ACWR (acute:chronic workload ratio) from the last 28 days of activities to assess overreach and injury risk

tools.name: get_fitness_trend
tools.description: Fetch VO2 Max values sampled weekly over the past 6 weeks to assess whether fitness is trending up, stable, or declining

tools.name: get_recent_activities
tools.description: Fetch the last 7 days of activities with distance, pace, average HR, and aerobic/anaerobic training effect scores

tools.name: analyze_run
tools.description: Fetch detailed running dynamics and form analysis for a specific activity. Returns cadence, stride length, ground contact time, ground contact balance, vertical oscillation, vertical ratio, running power, per-km splits, and HR zone breakdown with actionable form recommendations. If no activity_id is provided, analyses the most recent running activity.

tools.name: create_running_workout
tools.description: Create a structured running workout on Garmin Connect. Supports warmup, easy, interval (time or distance), recovery, cooldown, and repeat blocks. Returns the new workout_id which can be used with schedule_workout.

tools.name: create_strength_workout
tools.description: Create a strength/gym workout on Garmin Connect. Exercises can be rep-based (reps) or time-based (duration_seconds) for holds, planks, carries, etc. Each exercise becomes a set of work+rest steps on the watch. Returns the new workout_id which can be used with schedule_workout.

tools.name: schedule_workout
tools.description: Schedule an existing Garmin workout to a specific calendar date. Use after create_running_workout or create_strength_workout to assign it to a day.

tools.name: get_scheduled_workout
tools.description: Read the workout(s) scheduled on the Garmin Connect calendar for a given date (defaults to tomorrow). Returns the workout name, sport type, and the full step/exercise structure with paces/HR zones/durations/distances/sets/reps. Returns 'No workout scheduled for <date>' if nothing is scheduled.

tools.name: get_future_schedule
tools.description: Fetch scheduled workouts for the next N days (default 7, max 90) starting from today. Returns a day-by-day list of what is already on the Garmin Connect calendar, including manually rescheduled workouts. Use for planning context before creating new workouts.

tools.name: get_weekly_review
tools.description: Review this week's training vs last week. Compares distance, time, sessions, best session, and ACWR. Ends with a coming-week recommendation based on load.

tools.name: get_monthly_review
tools.description: Review this calendar month's training vs last month. Covers volume, consistency, longest run, VO2 Max movement, and a focus area for next month.

tools.name: get_run_window
tools.description: Check today's weather and recommend the best time window to run. Auto-detects current location via IP, or accepts an optional location name (e.g. 'Mallusk', 'Belfast'). Weekdays: morning and lunch slots. Weekends: all daylight windows. Scored on precipitation, temperature, wind, and UV.

tools.name: setup_training_plan
tools.description: Set up or update the overarching half-marathon training plan. Call with no arguments to fetch Garmin race predictions and get a questionnaire. Call with race_date and training_days_per_week (minimum) to create the plan. Once set, all daily coaching tools automatically include plan context.

tools.name: get_plan_status
tools.description: Show full training plan status: race details, current week and phase, predicted vs target time, weekly structure, and phase breakdown. Returns setup instructions if no plan exists.

tools.name: clear_training_plan
tools.description: Delete the current training plan. Requires confirmation=true. Use when starting a new training cycle.

tools.name: delete_workout
tools.description: Permanently delete a workout from the Garmin Connect workout library. This removes the template entirely and cannot be undone. To just remove from calendar, use unschedule_workout instead.

tools.name: unschedule_workout
tools.description: Remove a scheduled workout from the Garmin Connect calendar without deleting the workout template. The workout stays in the library and can be rescheduled later. Requires the scheduled_workout_id (calendar entry ID), not the workout template ID.

tools.name: log_workout_feedback
tools.description: Log a completed workout and post-run feedback (RPE, feel, niggles, notes) to the coaching history database. Links automatically to the current training cycle. Use after every session to build longitudinal coaching context.

tools.name: get_workout_history
tools.description: Retrieve logged workout history with feedback from the coaching database, ordered by date. The running coach uses this to identify fatigue patterns, load trends, and recurring niggles across weeks or entire training cycles.

tools.name: get_pending_suggestions
tools.description: Return all pending coaching suggestions that have not yet been approved or denied. Suggestions are generated automatically during the weekly review based on ACWR, volume trends, and session consistency. Each suggestion has an id, recommendation, rationale, and action_type. Use approve_suggestion to act on them.

tools.name: approve_suggestion
tools.description: Approve or deny a pending coaching suggestion by its id. Approved suggestions are logged as accepted coaching decisions. Denied suggestions are dismissed. Both outcomes are recorded for future review.

tools.name: get_daily_briefing
tools.description: Single-call morning briefing: readiness (HRV, sleep stages, Training Readiness score → GREEN/AMBER/RED), today's Garmin scheduled session, best weather window, and a unified go/modify/rest verdict. When AMBER/RED meets a quality session, proposes a swap and logs a coaching suggestion. Accepts optional location for weather.

tools.name: get_recovery_trend
tools.description: 14-day (configurable) day-by-day trend of HRV, resting HR, sleep score, body battery, and stress with slope-based direction and overreaching/illness flags.

tools.name: generate_week
tools.description: Generate and schedule a full week of training sessions on Garmin Connect based on plan phase, ACWR, blocked days, and personalized pace/HR targets from your lactate threshold. Requires an active training plan.

tools.name: get_race_strategy
tools.description: Race-day pacing strategy: goal vs Garmin prediction gap analysis, per-km pace bands, half-split targets, taper checklist, and race-day cues. Accepts an optional target_time override.

tools.name: get_fitness_scores
tools.description: Fetch Garmin's Endurance Score and Hill Score for today, with descriptive levels.

tools.name: set_exercise_defaults
tools.description: Set or update default weights, sets, and reps for strength exercises. Stored in the coaching database and auto-applied when creating strength workouts. Each variation (barbell, dumbbell, incline) is tracked separately.

tools.name: get_exercise_defaults
tools.description: View current default weights, sets, and reps for all tracked strength exercises, or filter to a specific exercise name.

tools.name: log_strength_progress
tools.description: Log per-exercise session outcomes. Completed exercises (all reps hit) get +10% weight suggestion; failed exercises get -10%. Set apply_changes=true to immediately update defaults for the next session.

tools.name: review_strength_workout
tools.description: Pull a completed strength activity from Garmin Connect and compare each exercise against stored defaults. Shows logged weight vs default, sets completed vs planned, and flags new exercises. Set apply_defaults=true to save logged weights as new defaults for all fully-completed exercises.

tools.name: dump_morning_raw
tools.description: Diagnostic tool. Dumps the raw API responses for HRV, heart rate, sleep, body battery, stress, and training readiness. Use when morning metrics show unexpected nulls to see exactly what Garmin is returning.

tools.name: dump_strength_activity
tools.description: Diagnostic tool. Dumps the raw exerciseSets payload from Garmin Connect for a completed strength activity. If no activity_id is given, uses the most recent fitness_equipment activity in the last 30 days.

profile_name.title: Profile Name
profile_name.description: Unique name for this coaching instance (e.g. 'kayleigh'). Namespaces the local database so multiple users on the same machine stay separate. Leave blank for the default profile.
